mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ordersetting WHERE DATE(order_date) = CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(reservations), 0) FROM t_ordersetting WHERE MONTH(order_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(order_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counselor WHERE status = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_result WHERE MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE())

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(reservations) AS count FROM t_ordersetting WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY order_date ASC

SELECT s.name AS name, s.price AS price, COUNT(r.id) AS sale_count FROM t_setmeal s LEFT JOIN t_report r ON r.setmeal_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.price ORDER BY sale_count DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 5
